javascript.details: The namespace is installed only after compile support, app opt-in, ONNX Runtime loading, and NeuralContext creation succeed. loadModel, loadModelFromBuffer, getModelInfo, and run throw InternalError for wrapper failures; invalid buffers and run inputs throw TypeError. Missing context or required arguments return -1, null, or undefined in selected native functions, unloadModel is a no-op, staged getOutput returns undefined when no output is cached, and getError returns the context error string or empty string.

lua.details: The namespace is installed only after compile support, app opt-in, ONNX Runtime loading, and NeuralContext creation succeed. luaL argument checks, model loading, metadata lookup, and inference failures raise Lua errors; unloadModel is a no-op only when no context exists. Staged getOutput returns nil when no output is cached, and getError returns the context error string or empty string.

wasmtime.details: When compiled, all imports register before app metadata is checked and host calls do not trap. Without an active context or valid memory/model/input/output, load operations return -1, count/info/error-copy/output-copy/shape queries return 0, run returns 0, and void operations silently do nothing. String copies are NUL-terminated and may truncate; tensor metadata and output copies can also truncate to fixed or guest-supplied capacities.

browser_wasm.reason: The web build includes no neural binding sources and the browser-native WebAssembly env object registers no neural_* imports.

availability_gates.behavior: The root build adds all neural wrapper and binding sources and defines BUDO_NEURAL only while ENABLE_NEURAL remains enabled after the ONNX headers check. Without those sources there is no valid neural export surface.

Android adds the managed neural sources, defines BUDO_NEURAL, and links the ABI-specific ONNX Runtime library only when the staged Android headers and shared library exist. Android exposes no Wasmtime runtime.
On desktop, app.json must contain neural: true before a context is created and sys.neural is installed for JavaScript or Lua.

Wasmtime env.neural_* imports are registered with instance-owned binding state while the canvas runtime is created, but app.json neural: true is required to create its NeuralContext. Without opt-in the imports remain and return failure sentinels.
On Android, app.json must contain neural: true before a context is created and sys.neural is installed for JavaScript or Lua.
Even in a neural-enabled build and opted-in app, sys.neural is installed only if the ONNX Runtime shared library can be loaded, its API resolved, and NeuralContext initialization succeeds.
Wasmtime imports remain registered when ONNX Runtime loading or context creation fails. neural_is_available returns 0 and context-dependent imports return their documented failure sentinels.

capability_relationships.unavailable_behavior: A false capability prevents managed context creation and sys.neural registration. A true capability is necessary but not sufficient because app.json neural opt-in and successful context creation are separate gates.
In a compiled neural build the Wasmtime imports remain registered; neural_is_available and capability_neural return 0, while context-dependent imports return sentinels or no-op.

details: Desktop JavaScript and Lua omit sys.neural unless both app metadata and context creation succeed.
Desktop Wasmtime registers env.neural_* before app metadata is checked, so imports can exist without an active context.
Each Wasmtime canvas owns its neural context, store/memory references, and staged model state; neural registration and memory wiring are omitted together when ENABLE_NEURAL is disabled.
Android packages optional ABI-specific ONNX Runtime libraries and exposes neural only to JavaScript and Lua.
Android has no Wasmtime guest runtime or env.neural_* import surface.
The web build includes neither managed neural bindings nor a browser-native WebAssembly neural bridge.
Type declarations and generic WebAssembly documentation are broader than the executable web surface.

operations.name: is_available
operations.signature: () -> bool indicating whether the ONNX Runtime library can be loaded

wasmtime.name: neural_is_available
wasmtime.signature: () -> i32; 1 available, 0 unavailable; independent of app opt-in and active context

javascript.name: getError
javascript.signature: () -> string; empty without context or error

lua.name: getError
lua.signature: () -> string; empty without context or error

wasmtime.name: neural_get_error
wasmtime.signature: (destination_ptr: i32, max_len: i32) -> i32 bytes written excluding NUL, truncated to max_len-1; 0 on failure or empty error

javascript.name: loadModel
javascript.signature: (path: string) -> number model_id; throws InternalError on wrapper failure, returns -1 for missing context/argument or failed string coercion

lua.name: loadModel
lua.signature: (path: string) -> integer model_id; raises Lua error on failure

wasmtime.name: neural_load_model
wasmtime.signature: (path_ptr: i32, path_len: i32) -> i32 model_id; -1 on invalid memory, missing context, unsafe path, or load failure; paths longer than 511 bytes are rejected

javascript.name: loadModelFromBuffer
javascript.signature: (data: ArrayBuffer|TypedArray) -> number model_id; throws TypeError for other values and InternalError on wrapper failure

lua.name: loadModelFromBuffer
lua.signature: (data: binary string) -> integer model_id; raises Lua error on failure

wasmtime.name: neural_load_model_from_buffer
wasmtime.signature: (data_ptr: i32, data_len: i32) -> i32 model_id; -1 for non-positive or out-of-bounds data, missing context, or load failure

javascript.name: unloadModel
javascript.signature: (model_id: number) -> void; also clears staged shim state

lua.name: unloadModel
lua.signature: (model_id: integer) -> nil; also clears staged shim state

wasmtime.name: neural_unload_model
wasmtime.signature: (model_id: i32) -> void; clears staged/cached binding state for in-range ids and otherwise silently delegates/no-ops

lua.name: getModelInfo
lua.signature: (model_id: integer) -> metadata table with 1-based inputs/outputs arrays; raises on failure

wasmtime.name: neural_get_input_count
wasmtime.signature: (model_id: i32) -> i32 count; 0 when context/model metadata is unavailable

wasmtime.name: neural_get_output_count
wasmtime.signature: (model_id: i32) -> i32 count; 0 when context/model metadata is unavailable

operations.name: get_input_info
operations.signature: (model_id, input_index) -> input name, shape, and rank

wasmtime.name: neural_get_input_info
wasmtime.signature: (model_id: i32, index: i32, name_destination: i32, name_max_len: i32, shape_i64_destination: i32) -> i32 rank; name is NUL-terminated/truncated, rank shape elements are written, 0 on failure; dtype is not returned

operations.name: get_output_info
operations.signature: (model_id, output_index) -> output name, shape, and rank

wasmtime.name: neural_get_output_info
wasmtime.signature: (model_id: i32, index: i32, name_destination: i32, name_max_len: i32, shape_i64_destination: i32) -> i32 rank; name is NUL-terminated/truncated, rank shape elements are written, 0 on failure; dtype is not returned

operations.name: set_input
operations.signature: stage a named tensor for the next inference

javascript.name: setInput
javascript.signature: (model_id: number, name: string, data: TypedArray, shape?: number[]) -> void; stores data without validation and ignores shape

lua.name: setInput
lua.signature: (model_id: integer, name: string, data: number[], shape?: integer[]) -> nil; stores a staged input table

wasmtime.name: neural_set_input_f32
wasmtime.signature: (model_id: i32, name_ptr: i32, name_len: i32, data_f32_ptr: i32, element_count: i32, shape_i64_ptr: i32, rank: i32) -> void; copies data, accepts only f32, and silently no-ops on invalid input

javascript.name: run
javascript.signature: (model_id: number, inputs?: Record<string,TypedArray>) -> Record<string,TypedArray>; omitted inputs use staged data; typed arrays must match model names/types/counts; throws on failure

lua.name: run
lua.signature: (model_id: integer, inputs?: table) -> table keyed by output name with {data,shape,dtype}; omitted inputs use staged data; raises on failure

wasmtime.name: neural_run
wasmtime.signature: (model_id: i32) -> i32; 1 success, 0 missing context/model/staged input or inference failure; staged inputs are cleared after each attempted run

operations.name: get_output
operations.signature: retrieve a named output from the most recent run

javascript.name: getOutput
javascript.signature: (model_id: number, name: string) -> TypedArray|undefined; returns the staged shim cache

lua.name: getOutput
lua.signature: (model_id: integer, name: string) -> {data,shape,dtype}|nil; returns the staged shim cache

wasmtime.name: neural_copy_output_f32
wasmtime.signature: (model_id: i32, name_ptr: i32, name_len: i32, destination_f32_ptr: i32, max_elements: i32) -> i32 elements copied, possibly truncated; 0 on failure; output dtype is not checked

operations.name: get_output_shape
operations.signature: retrieve the resolved shape of a named output

wasmtime.name: neural_get_output_shape
wasmtime.signature: (model_id: i32, name_ptr: i32, name_len: i32, destination_i64_ptr: i32, max_rank: i32) -> i32 actual rank; writes min(rank,max_rank) dimensions and returns 0 on failure
